name: Brownie
description: The brownie is a household tutelary spirit of Scottish and Northern English folklore — typically small, brown-skinned, hairy, and ragged — that performs farm and household labour at night in exchange for small offerings of cream, milk, or porridge, and that famously departs forever if offered new clothes or direct payment.
origin: Native to Lowland and Highland Scotland and to Northern England, with regional cognates throughout the British Isles. The figure travelled with Scots and English emigrants to Ulster and to North America.
